capture_plan_law: One pipeline run per case; the four planted defect classes must be REJECTED and the production cases must PASS through this exact template path (prereg -> capture -> two-stage gate -> receipts -> review export). Declared views per K02 prereg section 9: normal player camera; detail of the pad/trunk contact region; alternate-angle of the hold site; for the release arm additionally the fall/ground-contact frame - each in clean + diagnostic pairs. Case table declared before capture: hold_w20 / hold_w100 / hold_w300 / hold_mu041_slip carry the six normal+detail+alternate frames; release_to_ground carries the normal+alternate+fall pairs (the hold-site detail projection does not frame the release-end state; the fall/ground-contact frame is the declared release view); four defect cases run against the hold_w20 state.
exception_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 exception law: a frame passes only via an exception declared in the view-spec; every exception pass emits a machine receipt row with census evidence; prose-only exceptions are refused.
freeze_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 prereg law: thresholds are frozen in the view-spec; the gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame; any change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash.
prereg_note: Authored BEFORE capture; calibrated once from the measured census of dev capture run 3b3b44ae9cbb4c70ad7ffec121c1fe13 (fall classes only; all green classes untouched) and re-pinned as spec_version 2 BEFORE the sealed run.
